summary: Ships Go binary implementing PTY-over-WebSocket backdoor plus Anthropic API key harvester
details: The tarball's sole payload is a Go binary at bin/sxt that combines a PTY library (github.com/creack/pty) with a WebSocket client (github.com/coder/websocket) and hardcoded endpoints wss://relay.sextant.top and https://relay.sextant.top/install, implementing a remote-controlled interactive shell on the installer's host driven by the author-operated relay. The same binary contains a regex targeting Anthropic API keys (sk-ant-...) and references to CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and validates keys against https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models — reading Claude developer credentials from local configuration. It also performs host fingerprinting via http://ip-api.com/json (country, city, ISP, org, proxy, hosting, mobile) and contains strings pairing https://claude.ai/install.sh with sudo/curl orchestration. The package.json license field points to https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control, aligning the self-declared identity with the binary's Claude-credential harvesting and remote-shell behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
